payload.mission: Payment Gateway P0 Outage: 500 Error Spike Investigation & Autonomous Healing

scenes.title: Anomaly Triage & Prometheus Metrics Scan
scenes.objective: Query Prometheus for HTTP 500 spike and latency surge across payment-api instances.

scenes.title: Deep Stacktrace Hunting via Loki Logs
scenes.objective: Scan error logs in Loki to isolate precise fatal exception and blocked threads.

scenes.title: Blast Radius Audit & Self-Healing
scenes.objective: Evaluate pool expansion blast radius and authorize dynamic pool resizing.

payload.thought: P0 Alert triggered. Dispatching Observability Producer to interrogate Grafana Cloud Prometheus datasource for 5xx error rate.

payload.data_summary: PromQL confirmed acute 500 error spike: error rate surged from 0.02% to 42.1%.

payload.summary: Prometheus confirms acute 500 spike across all 8 payment-api pods. Throughput dropped by 78%.

payload.thought: Scene 1 confirmed system distress. Requesting Observability Producer to inspect Loki logs for raw stacktrace.

payload.data_summary: Loki extracted 34 stacktraces: DBConnectionPoolTimeout: connection pool exhausted (size=20, active=20, waiters=142).

payload.summary: Root cause pinpointed: Backend Postgres connection pool saturated under Black Friday traffic surge.
payload.stacktrace: ERROR [payment.db] DBConnectionPoolTimeout: connection pool exhausted (size=20, active=20, waiters=142)

payload.thought: Root cause isolated. Formulating remediation proposal: Dynamic pool scale-up from 20 to 100. Submitting to Studio Head for safety audit.

payload.action_proposed: Dynamic DB Connection Pool Scale Up (20 -> 100) & Non-blocking Worker Reload
payload.justification: Target deployment is stateless. Scaling pool requires zero downtime and will immediately alleviate DB waiter queues.

payload.action: Dynamic DB Connection Pool Scale Up (20 -> 100)
payload.system_state_post_healing: HEALTHY (Error Rate: 0.01%, P99 Latency: 48ms, Active Connections: 48/100)

payload.mission: Payment Gateway P0 Outage: 500 Error Spike Investigation & Autonomous Healing
payload.root_cause_identified: Database connection pool exhausted (size=20/20 active) causing 42% HTTP 500 spike.
payload.remediation_status: SUCCESS: Pool dynamically scaled to 100 with zero downtime. Error rate dropped to 0.01%.
payload.telemetry_evidence_summary: Corroborated across Prometheus metrics and Loki log traces via Grafana MCP.
payload.cost_and_performance_impact: Estimated savings of $18,400 in prevented transaction dropouts; P99 latency recovered from 4210ms to 48ms.
